purpose: C3 P0 solver cross-check, MIPR downgrade verification, and LOVO prediction audit

fixed_protocol.note: Smoke-only protocol; metrics do not establish converged accuracy superiority.

solver_runs.prediction_note: Historical run predates the prediction-evidence fix.
Historical run predates the prediction-evidence fix.

fallback.reason: OR-Tools is not installed; the V-PEFT path explicitly downgraded MIPR to AO and recorded both requested and effective solvers.

reproduced_bug.error: PlacementPlan rank 64 for '1.conv' exceeds layer capacity 16
reproduced_bug.root_cause: The hard-constraint registry did not enforce rank <= min(in_channels, out_channels), so DCO could emit a plan rejected by PlacementPlan.validate_model().
reproduced_bug.fix: VariantModuleCompatibilityConstraint now applies the same layer-capacity invariant before solver projection.
reproduced_bug.runner_secondary_error: The evidence runner attempted adapter export after a failed training process and raised FileNotFoundError for the missing checkpoint.
reproduced_bug.runner_fix: Failed runs now skip adapter export while still writing available config, artifacts, recovery analysis, and result evidence.

prediction_evidence.interpretation: This is an auditable prior prediction, not a measured delta and not a fitted LOVO result. At least five unique observations are required before calibration.

conclusion.reason: Under the fixed smoke protocol AO was about 14x faster in solver time and used about 7x fewer planned adapter parameters than DCO. One-epoch detection metrics are excluded from method-quality claims.
conclusion.lovo_status: runtime null removed, but learned LOVO calibration remains pending because no observations are available
